thread:
oncall-bot: 🚨 Paging: p99 tail latency breach detected on continuous-batching path (svc=runtime-cont, region=us-west-2). Alert: p99 > 1.8s for 3m.
Lina: saw it. I'm on it — grabbing logs and queue metrics.
Ravi: I can help — any customer-facing errors?
Lina: ops-monitor shows spike in streaming stalls + increased queue depth on cont-batch worker pool. Few 504s reported to client side. No full outage.
Jules: logs look like a small subset of requests with very long seq-lengths are inflating batch formation time. Mixed sequence lengths causing scheduler to wait to fill large batches.
Samir: timeline? when did the drop start?
Lina: start ~1790123400, alert fired 1790123456. We see cont-batch headway increase from 50ms -> 700ms for some shards.
Deb: customer impact: Support reported 3 customers with degraded real-time streaming (low throughput, stalls). Flagging as P1 for now since streaming sessions degrade UX.
Ravi: hypothesis: continuous-batching scheduler is favoring throughput, waiting for larger sequences, which delays small/streaming sessions. We need fairness enforcement + quicker batch cutoff.
Jules: agree. Quick mitigations: 1) lower max_batch_size for cont-batch to reduce wait time 2) enable fairshare per-session token limit 3) set fast_batch_cutoff_ms to 30ms.
Lina: can we do at infra layer without deploy? runtime exposes dynamic config via /admin/config.
Ravi: doing a controlled change now: `curl -X POST http://admin-usw2/runtime/config -d '{"cont_batch.max_size":8,"cont_batch.cutoff_ms":30}'` — applying to pool-3.
ops-monitor: config apply acknowledged on pool-3 (instance set: pool-3a,b,c).
Lina: monitoring metrics: p50 stable, p95 dropping from 450ms -> 220ms, p99 still at ~1.2s but trending down.
Samir: also evicting long-KV cache entries for sessions with seq_len>512 to speed up kv lookups: `runtimectl evict-kv --selector 'seq_len>512'`
Jules: small note: that eviction may cause short-term token regen for some seq heavy users but should lower scheduling jitter.
Deb: notifying Support: "We applied mitigations (batch size + cutoff + KV eviction). We're seeing improvement; will follow up in 30m with full impact summary."
Lina: shifting to keep an eye on streaming stall counts and 5xx at ingress. Also enabling a temporary route-level fallback to smaller model variant for streaming customers: `routectl set fallback=fast-small --match route:streaming`
ops-monitor: streaming stall metric down 60% in 6m, p99 down to 650ms. No new 5xx.
Ravi: good. I'll leave a tracing session on the affected requests for 15m to catch any stragglers.
Jules: adding a throttling policy for mixed-seq requests: prioritize low-latency sessions in scheduler until we stabilize.
Lina: handoff: I'm heading to a meeting in 10m. @Ravi you'll take next 30m?
Ravi: I got it. Lina, drop any remaining commands in the thread pls.
Lina: noted. Live notes: applied cont_batch.max_size=8, cutoff_ms=30, evicted high-seq KV, enabled route fallback. Observed: p99 improved from >1.8s -> ~600ms, streaming stalls down. Customer impact reduced.
Deb: please prepare a brief incident summary for comms: customers impacted, mitigations, ETA for postmortem.
Ravi: will draft. Action items: 1) Jules to add per-session queue timeout to scheduler (short-term) 2) Eng-runtime to add weighted fairshare for mixed seqs (medium) 3) Product to review SLAs for streaming (assess).
Jules: already on a branch for fairshare; will open PR with tests today.
Lina: handing off to @Ravi now — leaving a runbook pointer: https://intra.redwood/sys/runbooks/cont-batch-tail (note: runbook needs update).
Ravi: taking over — will monitor for 30m, then escalate if p99 > 800ms or new 5xx.
oncall-bot: @Ravi you have the incident. Reminder: create an incident ticket if you escalate.
Lina: thx team :thumbsup: — posting summary to #incidents in 20m if stable.
Ravi: quick note for postmortem: capture seq_len distribution, batch formation latency per shard, and schedule fairness traces.
Deb: confirmed outreach to affected customers started.
ops-monitor: final metric snapshot at 1790123610: p50=120ms, p95=210ms, p99=610ms, streaming_stalls=-62% vs peak.
Ravi: closing live mitigation loop. Will open incident ticket with timeline and action items.
Lina: back on call for follow-ups if anything pops.
Jules: PR link for fairshare will be posted in the incident ticket.
Samir: thanks everyone, good coordination.
